title: Gap Sense
description: AI Skill Gap & Career Trend Platform.
detailedDescription: Led a 4-person Dicoding capstone team and proposed the core product idea. Built backend services, preprocessing workflows, semantic gap analysis, Groq-based AI career consultation, and final Streamlit integration. Deployed the FastAPI/AI backend to Hugging Face Spaces and the dashboard to gapsense.streamlit.app.

title: Luxe News
detailedDescription: Built the Laravel backend, Filament CMS resources, database models, and REST API endpoints for news, games, tournaments, categories, banners, and comments. Integrated backend-managed content into the React frontend and finalized frontend behavior with the team. Implemented admin content workflows, slug-based routing support, Laravel Sanctum authentication, and MySQL-backed data management.

title: SeaBank Sentiment Analysis
description: NLP Classification Project on Google Play reviews.
detailedDescription: Built a sentiment analysis system for 15,000 SeaBank Google Play reviews labeled as positive, neutral, and negative from app ratings. Compared SBERT + Dense Neural Network, SVM + TF-IDF, and Random Forest + Bag of Words; achieved 91.46% testing accuracy with SBERT + Dense Neural Network and 91.85% with SVM + TF-IDF.

title: Insect Pest Classifier
detailedDescription: Trained a DenseNet121 transfer learning model to classify 5 insect pest classes from 13,272 images and reached approximately 88.76% validation accuracy. Fine-tuned the last 50 layers and exported the trained model into SavedModel, TensorFlow Lite, and TensorFlow.js formats.

title: Digital Twin Solar Panel Monitoring
detailedDescription: Connected Unity, broker, and AI components so monitoring data could be displayed in a web-based 3D solar panel model. Supported data integration for an academic digital twin system focused on solar panel monitoring and visualization.
